note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. Twenty-four candidates were returned unopposed for the 28 seats, three retiring members were automatically returned in divisions with no nominations, and Lislea, reported in the nominations as a contest, was settled without a poll: the Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Strabane Chronicle, 28 September 1946, p. 2) declares Dunn elected there, no poll having been taken. The nomination reports had Lislea contested between James Alexander Smyth (U.) and Robert Andrew Dunn (Ind.); the Returning Officer's notice, published before polling day, lists Lislea among the divisions where no poll was taken, with Dunn elected. Full name from the nomination report. Returned unopposed.
